ARTEMIS · deck template

How ARTEMIS documents a finding

Copy this file to docs/<topic>/presentation.html, keep the <style> and <script> blocks, and replace the slides. It is one self-contained file: it opens from disk, attaches to an email, and needs no build.

one claim per slide every slide cites its source commands over copied tables deep links #slide-id

Use ← → or space to move through the deck. Swipe on a phone.

Conventions 01

Prose drifts; code does not. Put each fact where it cannot go stale.

Kind of factWhere it livesWhy there
A rule the code must obeyA check in scripts/check_conventions.py, or a raise in the moduleIt fails when broken; a sentence does not
How to call a functionA doctest in the module docstringscripts/check_docs.py runs it, so the example cannot lie
A policy tableThe YAML in config/, printed by python -m <module>The config is the authority; a copy is a second, wrong authority
How to run a stage--help on the moduleargparse cannot document a flag that does not exist
A finding, a design, a decisionA deck like this oneA reader has to understand it, and it has to say what it rests on
Markdown is budgeted. scripts/check_docs.py holds a line ceiling for every surviving .md file and refuses new ones. Ceilings only go down.

scripts/check_docs.py · scripts/check_conventions.py

Component · stat tiles 02

Lead with the number, then say what it is a number of

Headings are claims, not topics. "Forty percent of the AOI has no TreeMap value" — not "Holes".

190.41
good: the result you are reporting
47 / 80
warn: the result that limits it
11,831
plain: context the reader needs
0.088
four across; two across under 760 px

.tiles / .tiles.three · .tile .n.good / .n.warn · .tile .l

Component · cards 04

Cards for two or three parallel arguments

What was found tag

Body text states the evidence. Numbers in bold, identifiers in mono.

Rule: a .say line carries the one sentence a reader should keep.

What it does not show tag warn

Use .cards.three for three. They stack to one column under 860 px.

uv run python -m pipeline.spatial_ref
# .run blocks show a command and, optionally, what it printed
Caveats get their own box. Anything that limits a claim — sampling frame, post-selection, an unverified input — goes in .caveat, never in a footnote.

.cards / .cards.three · .tcard h4 .tag(.warn|.open) · .say · .caveat · pre.run .cmd / .note

Component · figures 07

Figures are embedded, so the deck stays one file

Inline a PNG as src="data:image/png;base64,…". Write real alt text: what the figure shows and its key numbers, not "chart". Commit the script that draws it and name that script in the srcline.

figure.fig > img + figcaption · path/to/make_figure.py

Closing 08

End on the claims, in one list

  • One bullet per claim the deck made — bold the claim, then the number behind it.
  • State the limit last — what the evidence does not establish.
Checklist before committing: every slide has an id and a srcline; every number traces to a committed file or a command; uv run python scripts/check_docs.py passes.
